timeline.limitations: ERNIE 5.0 托管于百度千帆平台；ERNIE 4.5 中小尺寸权重开源可商用。
timeline.limitations_en: ERNIE 5.0 via Qianfan cloud; ERNIE 4.5 family open-weight.

timeline.title: Amazon推出 Nova Premier 旗舰与 Nova Act 网页操作 Agent，并升级 Bedrock 企业多模型编排
timeline.title_en: AWS expands Amazon Nova Premier flagship & Nova Act browser agent inside Amazon Bedrock
timeline.what_it_does: 让企业在统一 IAM 权限与合规审计下同时调用 Nova、Claude 及开源权重，并用 Nova Act 稳定自动完成跨网页流程。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Unifies browser-action agents and multi-model enterprise inference routing under AWS IAM governance.
timeline.who_cares: AWS 企业云架构师、高并发生产服务团队
timeline.limitations: 完全依托 AWS 云平台托管与按量计费。
timeline.limitations_en: Managed cloud service exclusive to Amazon Bedrock.

timeline.title: Meta AI 推出 Llama 4 (Scout / Maverick) 开源多模态 MoE 家族：支持千万级超长上下文与端侧轻量化
timeline.title_en: Meta AI releases open-weight Llama 4 Scout and Maverick natively multimodal MoE models
timeline.what_it_does: 率先把开源基座切入原生图文混合专家架构与千万级上下文窗口，配合 ExecuTorch 优化端侧运行。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Brings native multimodal MoE and up to 10M context window to the open-weight Llama ecosystem.
timeline.who_cares: 全球开源模型开发者、长文档分析与端侧 AI 团队
timeline.limitations: 遵循 Llama 社区许可协议，超大规模月活商业机构需额外申请授权。
timeline.limitations_en: Llama Community License terms apply for >700M MAU organizations.

timeline.title: Google 正式开放「Gemini 4 Argon（氩）」GA 接口：9月30日官宣后全量落地长程科研与编程推理
timeline.title_en: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Argon GA following Sept 30 unveiling for agentic coding and science
timeline.what_it_does: Argon 作为 Gemini 4 系列首款元素命名旗舰，打通多步代码重构与跨文档推理验证，为后续 Hydrogen/Carbon/Neon 分层铺路。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Serves as the inaugural Gemini 4 element-codenamed flagship for multi-step coding and scientific verification.
timeline.who_cares: AI 应用架构师、科研团队与企业 Gemini API 开发者
timeline.limitations: 闭源商业模型，通过 Gemini API 与 Vertex AI 提供服务。
timeline.limitations_en: Closed commercial API via Gemini API and Vertex AI.

timeline.title: 华为开放 openPangu 开源权重矩阵，联动盘古 5.5 与昇腾 Ascend CANN 实现自主算力全栈推理
timeline.title_en: Huawei expands openPangu open checkpoints and Pangu 5.5 native inference on Ascend NPU stacks
timeline.what_it_does: 针对昇腾 NPU 超节点集群深度定制 CANN 算子与 MoE 并行策略，解决国产大型智算中心自主替代与行业部署痛点。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Delivers Ascend NPU CANN-tuned open weights and sovereign enterprise deployment.
timeline.who_cares: 国产算力基础设施团队、能源制造与政务数字化工程师
timeline.limitations: 全栈硬件最优加速针对华为昇腾系列 NPU 服务器。
timeline.limitations_en: Peak hardware kernels target Huawei Ascend NPU servers.

timeline.category: 开源 MoE 与代码模型
timeline.title: Mistral AI 推进 Mistral Large 3 开源矩阵、Magistral 多语种推理与 Codestral 25 代码模型
timeline.title_en: Mistral AI updates Mistral Large 3 open weights, Magistral reasoning, and Codestral 25
timeline.what_it_does: 以宽松 Apache 2.0 许可提供高效多语种开源模型与超低延迟 IDE 代码补全，主打欧洲数据合规与本地部署。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Delivers permissive Apache-2.0 multilingual models and ultra-low-latency coding completion.
timeline.who_cares: 注重开源合规、隐私本地化与代码补全的全球开发者
timeline.limitations: 旗舰多模态及云端企业 SLA 需通过 Mistral La Plateforme 计费。
timeline.limitations_en: Managed enterprise SLAs billed via Mistral La Plateforme.

timeline.category: 开源多模态与视觉生成
timeline.title: Stability AI 扩展 Stable Virtual Camera (3D视角生成) 与 Stable Diffusion 3.5 / Audio 2.5 本地工作流
timeline.title_en: Stability AI advances Stable Virtual Camera (SEVA), SD 3.5, and Stable Audio 2.5 local creative stack
timeline.what_it_does: 支持从单张参考图生成自由运镜 3D 多视角视频，并与 ComfyUI 无缝对接实现消费级显卡局部可控创作。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Synthesizes camera-controlled 3D views from single images alongside ComfyUI-ready SD 3.5 and audio tools.
timeline.who_cares: 视觉设计师、游戏 3D 美术与本地 AIGC 创作者
timeline.limitations: 企业年营收超 100 万美元商用需购买 Stability Enterprise 许可。
timeline.limitations_en: Free community license for small teams; enterprise tier required above $1M revenue.

timeline.title: 百度千帆与飞桨 FastDeploy 全面升级 ERNIE X1 长文档 RAG 校验与低延迟推理流水线
timeline.title_en: Baidu Qianfan & Paddle FastDeploy upgrade ERNIE X1 RAG grounding and low-latency serving
timeline.what_it_does: 增强检索引用溯源与表格复杂文档解析，显著降低企业私有知识库问答幻觉率。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Improves enterprise document table parsing and citation-grounded RAG accuracy.
timeline.who_cares: 企业 AI 中台团队、政务与金融合规问答开发者
timeline.limitations: 深度算子加速需匹配飞桨 PaddlePaddle 运行时环境。
timeline.limitations_en: Optimized runtime relies on PaddlePaddle deployment stack.

timeline.title: Cursor Tab 升级跨文件跳转预测架构：投机解码将多行代码补全延迟再降 40%
timeline.title_en: Cursor Tab upgrades multi-file jump prediction using speculative decoding for 40% lower latency
timeline.what_it_does: 不仅补全当前行，还能主动预判开发者下一个要跳转修改的头文件、类型定义或测试用例位置。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Predicts cross-file cursor jumps and multi-line edits with sub-100ms speculative decoding.
timeline.who_cares: 重度 IDE 代码编写者与低延迟补全模型研究者
timeline.limitations: 深度集成于 Cursor 桌面客户端。
timeline.limitations_en: Integrated exclusively inside the Cursor editor.

timeline.title: Apple Private Cloud Compute (PCC) 发布可验证无状态加密审计升级，保障跨 App 智能体隐私
timeline.title_en: Apple upgrades Private Cloud Compute verifiable stateless security architecture for cross-app agents
timeline.what_it_does: 向独立安全研究者公开可验证加密镜像与零留存证明，确保端云协同复杂任务中用户个人数据不留存服务端。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Provides cryptographically verifiable stateless cloud inference protecting user privacy during heavy agent tasks.
timeline.who_cares: 安全审计工程师、企业移动设备管理与苹果生态用户
timeline.limitations: 仅限 Apple 硬件生态内系统级加密调用。
timeline.limitations_en: Exclusive to Apple ecosystem Private Cloud Compute endpoints.

timeline.title: Amazon Nova Sonic 双向实时语音流正式商用，面向全球客服与跨语种会议降本增效
timeline.title_en: Amazon Nova Sonic real-time speech-to-speech model enters general availability on AWS
timeline.what_it_does: 支持超低延迟拟真语音对话中断打断与后端业务 API 实时查询，直接取代传统级联语音机器人。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Replaces legacy ASR-LLM-TTS pipelines with unified real-time conversational speech endpoints.
timeline.who_cares: 企业呼叫中心、SaaS 客服产品与语音交互团队
timeline.limitations: 按流式音频时长通过 AWS Bedrock 区域计费。
timeline.limitations_en: Metered real-time audio streaming via AWS Bedrock.

timeline.title: Stability AI 发布 Stable Audio 2.5：企业级可商用配乐音效与分钟级结构化编曲
timeline.title_en: Stability AI releases Stable Audio 2.5 for structured commercial music and sound design
timeline.what_it_does: 基于授权音频数据训练，面向广告影视与游戏开发者提供无版权纠纷的风险可控完整曲目生成。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Generates structured full-length tracks trained on licensed catalogs for commercial production.
timeline.who_cares: 游戏音效师、影视后期团队与广告制作人
timeline.limitations: 高阶商业编曲托管于 Stability API。
timeline.limitations_en: Commercial Audio 2.5 inference hosted on Stability platform.

timeline.title: Google 发布「Gemini 3.5 Pro / Gemini 3.5 Flash」：200万上下文与原生实时音视频工具链成型
timeline.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.5 Pro and Flash with 2M context and low-latency native audio-video tools
timeline.what_it_does: 大幅降低长视频与超大规模代码库检索延迟，Flash 版本将企业高并发多模态路由成本压缩至上一代三分之一。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Cuts long-video and repo retrieval latency while Flash reduces high-concurrency multimodal API cost.
timeline.who_cares: 音视频开发者、企业搜索与多模态客服工程团队
timeline.limitations: 闭源 API 分级配额。
timeline.limitations_en: Closed API with tiered quotas.

timeline.title: Google DeepMind 发布 Veo 3 与 Lyria 2 原生音画同步生成引擎，并深化 AlphaEvolve 数学发现
timeline.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Veo 3 synchronized video-audio synthesis alongside AlphaEvolve
timeline.what_it_does: Veo 3 支持原生对白、环境音效与物理规律一致性渲染；AlphaEvolve 进化式代码智能体在矩阵乘法等基础算法上刷新纪录。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Veo 3 delivers native audio-video physics while AlphaEvolve discovers new algorithmic bounds.
timeline.who_cares: 影视创作团队、基础数学与高性能计算研究人员
timeline.limitations: Veo 3 经由 Vertex AI 与 Flow 商用，含 SynthID 水印。
timeline.limitations_en: Hosted on Vertex AI / Flow with SynthID watermarking.
